title: GWM Tank 400 is unveiled in Brazil and becomes one of the most searched topics
seoTitle: GWM Tank 400 unveiled in Brazil, top searched topic
subtitle: GWM's new hybrid SUV was revealed and generated great public interest.
excerpt: The hybrid Tank 400 SUV was presented to the Brazilian public, standing out with robust details, a powerful engine, and generous dimensions.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The new hybrid SUV Tank 400 caught the attention of the Brazilian public and ranks among the most searched topics after being officially presented at the Interlagos Festival. The model arrives with the aim of challenging established competitors in the national market and features an electrified powertrain.

Presentation at the Interlagos Festival

The Interlagos Cars Festival was the chosen stage to showcase the Tank 400 to the public. The event takes place from August 27 to 30 in São Paulo (SP), marking the appearance of the utility vehicle whose official launch is scheduled for 2026.

Dimensions and design of the new SUV

The Tank 400 adopts smoother lines and includes visual elements that recall rivals in the segment, such as the side profile that rises at the rear doors. In terms of size, the model measures 4.98 meters in length, 1.95 meters in width, 1.9 meters in height, and has a 2.85‑meter wheelbase. At the rear, the trunk lid opens sideways and carries the spare tire mounted on the outer side.

Hybrid powertrain and performance

The model uses a powertrain that combines an internal‑combustion engine with an electric motor. The system delivers high combined power and elevated torque, allowing the vehicle to accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in 6.8 seconds.

Technology and interior finish

Inside, the vehicle features soft‑touch materials, a discreet colour palette, and a 16.3‑inch multimedia screen, accompanied by a 12.3‑inch digital instrument cluster. The SUV also offers two inductive phone chargers and a gear selector positioned exclusively on the steering column.

With information from G1, Estadão, Diário do Poder.
